description:
## A fast, affordable set for driving scenes

Shoot inside a **real vintage Mercedes** on the 2nd floor of the studio — no picture-car rental, no vehicle delivery, no permits, no traffic, no weather problems.

Perfect for music videos, commercials, short films, dialogue scenes, fashion content, reels and photoshoots.

### Self-service — $69/hr
The base booking includes full access to the Car Set studio, the Mercedes, multiple shooting angles, and staging space with makeup and fitting. Bring your own lights, projectors, screens, cameras and crew — build the setup your way and only pay for the studio and the car.

### Full Car Process Package — +$99/hr
Want everything ready when you walk in? The full package adds:
- Two projectors + two projection screens
- Green screens
- Basic lighting and grip equipment
- Access to the background playback library
- Full setup for your shoot

Project moving city streets, highways, tunnels or night driving — or your own custom footage — and create the scene directly in camera. The Mercedes remains stationary.

Choose **Self-Service** if you have your own equipment. Choose the **Full Package** if you want to arrive with camera and talent and start shooting.
